title: Immer unterwegs / Campaign build

location.series: DB new design / original GIF demonstrations

slide_intent: Sequence a campaign message so the reader can identify the sender, read the offer and retain the image.
strategic_value: A staged white headline and red Schwelle can make a human travel scene feel unmistakably DB.
demonstration: The DB logo, two-line IMMER UNTERWEGS headline, small copy and red Schwelle build over a woman holding a phone beside a train, then withdraw.
practical_value: Compare the order of logo, headline, copy and Schwelle rather than animating every element at once.

content_islands.name: Photographic stage
content_islands.spec: Keep the woman and train full-frame, with message elements at left and the Schwelle along the bottom.

reference_purposes.Application: The animation applies a staged identity and message sequence to a photographic campaign composition.
